in_marathi.name: Sasi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sasi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sasi is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sasya’, which means the ‘god of the moon’. It is believed that the name Sasi is a representation of the moon god, Soma, who is considered to be the god of the moon and the giver of nourishment to the earth.
